title: Work Unit
description: The model-agnostic work-unit + acceptance-contract spec. The single stable interface between Layer A (engine) and Layer B (a cause). The portable payload is objective + inputs + output_schema + acceptance_contract; everything model-specific is synthesized locally by an adapter (not in scope for this spec).

schema_version.description: Semver of the work-unit spec this unit was authored against. validate_work_unit accepts a unit whose MAJOR equals the spec's MAJOR. See SPEC.md versioning rule.

task_id.description: Stable unique id; ties a result back to its unit; dedup / sybil anchor.

cause_id.description: First-class cause binding. Which coordinated effort this unit serves; each cause owns its own ledger / partner-bindings / trust-core.

objective.description: Natural-language statement of the task outcome. Model-agnostic; the adapter renders this into a runtime-native call.

inputs.description: The data to operate on: EITHER inline data OR a content-addressed pointer + hash. Exactly one form.

inline.description: Inline input data of any JSON-representable shape.

pointer.description: Content-addressed pointer to the input blob (e.g. a CID or ledger path). Resolution is a later-phase concern; the spec only carries the reference.

hash.description: Cryptographic hash of the referenced content, for content-addressed integrity.

output_schema.description: JSON Schema describing the required result structure. The runtime-agnostic contract; the more structured, the cheaper objective verification becomes. Carried as an embedded schema document; not itself validated against the draft meta-schema here.

acceptance_contract.description: Machine-checkable predicates a valid result must satisfy (format, required fields, value ranges, citations-required, refusal-handling). The validator hook (BOINC-analog). evaluate_acceptance runs these client-side; the deferred verify-layer quorum sits above it.

predicates.description: Conjunctive: ALL predicates must pass for the contract to pass.

capability_floor.description: Minimum capability the unit needs. Lets the dispatcher route units away from runtimes that can't do them. Model-agnostic WITHIN a capability tier, not uniformly. Self-declared capability is itself untrusted (calibration probe is a later phase).

tools.description: Tool capabilities the runtime must have (e.g. "web_fetch", "code_exec").

redundancy_policy.description: Redundancy + quorum config the (deferred) verify layer consumes. This spec ships the fields; no quorum logic.

target_nresults.description: Number of independent result instances to request.

min_quorum.description: Minimum agreeing results required to accept a canonical result.

model_diversity.description: Minimum number of DISTINCT model families that must contribute (the anti-collusion primitive). 0 = no diversity requirement.

provenance_requirements.description: What the runtime must attest per result. Feeds the deferred audit-trail / transparency ledger.

model_family.description: Must the result declare its model family?

signed_result.description: Must the result be cryptographically signed (A2A agent card)?

trace.description: Must the result include an execution trace?

deadline.description: Optional absolute ISO-8601 deadline for the unit.

lease.description: Optional claim lease; reclaim-and-reissue on expiry (BOINC-style). Claim/CAS logic is a later phase (ledger).

duration_seconds.description: How long a claim is held before the unit can be reissued.

predicate.description: A single machine-checkable acceptance predicate. Pure function over a result dict; no LLM, no network.

kind.description: Which predicate checker to run. Each kind has its own required params (see SPEC.md).
